newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks may rise again this week.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks may rise again this week.

text.p: Singapore stocks may firm again this week as foreign fund buying continues to soak up relatively inexpensive blue chip stocks, dealers said on Monday.
They said New York's strong close on Friday would also be a bullish factor.
* Benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index ended 23.85 points, or 1.07 percent, up at 2,244.21 on Friday after hitting an earlier low of 2,220.36.
* Friday's daily volume very high, over 327 million shares, reflecting inflow of funds from the United States and Britain.

* Attention seen focusing on Singapore's export data for December on Monday due out at 2.30 p.m. (0630 GMT). Reuters' poll predicts key non-oil domestic exports figure will show rise of 2.9 percent year-on-year.
* Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 67.73 points to 6,833.10 on Friday, another record.
